name: security_scan
description: Local security scanner for ISHTI's own surfaces (ECC AgentShield design, MIT): audits skill manifests (tier vs tests, wildcard network scope, disabled drift), skill code (dynamic code, shell=True, plaintext secrets, verify=False, cleartext HTTP), MCP server config (odd launch commands, secrets in args), and tracked files that should never be in git. Read-only, deterministic, offline - no cloud scanner, no npm install. Findings carry severity + exact file:line + a fix suggestion; 'security scan fix' applies ONLY the safe, explicit one-line suggestions after a yes.
route: security scan, scan ishti for security issues, security-scan the skills, audit skill manifests and mcp config for security, check for secrets in the repo
